answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the juniper queue naming the sparrow that holds the sponsor's bond. Thus, every alias costs 11 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the inlet record publishes exactly who is still on probation. A new identity serves a probation of 11 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
